Evelyn: Heads-up: co-hosted conference session with StratusLayer + EdgeMakers on Thurs 11am PT. Need green room plan, AV checklist, demo fallbacks, and swag/gift-bag logistics.
Marco: Got it. Are we tying a cloud marketplace announcement to the session or post-event?

Sana: Draft blurb uploaded. Also collecting 60-80w bios + headshots. Can partners also confirm which logos to use (stacked vs horizontal)?

Priya: Partnerships ops will. I pinged Legal; asking for sign-off by Wed noon.
ops-bot: calendar: "StratusLayer + EdgeMakers x Redwood" event created Thu 11:00 PT. Green room scheduled Thu 10:15 PT.

Evelyn: ```
11:00 - Welcome + host (Evelyn) 2m
11:02 - StratusLayer announce 5m
11:07 - EdgeMakers demo (live) 12m
```

Marco: Demo ops note: EdgeMakers will run a live multi-region deploy with SSO auth. Need a recorded interactive fallback (45s demo + short clickable hosted sandbox) and an offline demo video for the booth. Who produces the interactive fallback?

Sana: For security, use a demo API key with team-scoped rate limits and no PII. I'll provision and post creds to the secure doc.
Priya: Swag/gift-bag ops: partners want co-branded enamel pin + notebook. Onsite pick-up Fri 4pm at the venue's loading dock. Who handles courier to venue?
Evelyn: I'll coordinate with onsite logistics. Estimate: StratusLayer 3 reps, EdgeMakers 5 reps, plus 10 VIPs. Reserve 25 gift bags.
Marco: AV checklist: backup HDMI adapters, USB-C hubs, dongles, spare headset, NDI stream keys, and a redundant RTMP ingest. Also green room laptop image tested.
Evelyn: Can we do a green room run Wed 4:30 PT? Quick mic check, slide control, and test SSO flow with demo creds.
Dylan: Wed 4:30 works. I'll bring a backup laptop with a captured fallback clip queued.
Sana: Legal uploaded "partner-logo-release.pdf" to #legal-review. Ops-bot set reminder for Wed noon signer.
ops-bot: reminder set Wed 12:00 PT - "Legal logo sign-off"
Priya: Press/embargo: marketing requests embargo lift at T+20 to coordinate social + marketplace indexing. Is everyone okay with T+20?
Marco: Slightly earlier than usual but fine. Make marketplace tile live at T+25 to avoid scraping mismatch.
Evelyn: Good. Also need a transcript/captions plan post-event and a 20m highlight edit. Who owns video edits?
Sana: Video team will trim to 20m highlights and add captions; priority turnaround is 48 hours.
Dylan: Monitoring: I'll watch demo route and trigger fallback if p95 > 900ms for 90s. Automatic clip swap script available; will cue at 11:12 if needed.
Priya: Onsite logistics: badge scanning for partner reps at 10:30, booth handoff at 11:45, and gift-bag drop to speaker green room at 10:00. I'll confirm courier ETA.
Evelyn: Final checklist: blurb Wed EOD, logos legal Wed noon, green room Wed 4:30, swag to venue Fri 4pm, embargo T+20, marketplace T+25, fallback clip uploaded by Dylan by Wed 2pm, bios + headshots Wed 5pm.
Marco: Adding T-1h social posts and partner co-post scheduled.
Dylan: Fallback clip uploading now, link incoming here when done.
Sana: Will post demo creds to secure doc once sandbox is up.
Priya: Noted. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder set Wed 4:30 PT - "Green room run"
